page.layout: One printed page: an engraved architectural title frame with the title text in the centre, eight small framed panels in the left and right margins (four each side) on pillars, the engraved arch and emblems at top. No running head, no page number visible apart from a small mark at top right corner which is not text.

main_text.l: utq; facis, proprijs dotibus adde decus,
Quin liceat nobis in Te hoc spectare Theatrum
Queis nil de Te SPES tanta negare potest.
Doctrina et Iure | IOACHIM a. Æ. 1499
Magnanimitate | FRIDERICVS I. Radix Electoralis. Æ. 1417

page.notes: Engraving at top with a crown, a hand holding a sword at left and right, and clouds; described, not transcribed. Two small marks at top right corner are not text. Panel texts are transcribed as lines; the panel abbreviations (Æ. for Anno) are as read. Some panel lines are uncertain: Eloquentia "Cicero Germa-nicus", Felicitate "Achilles Ger-manicus", and Magnanimitate "Radix Electoralis" are best readings.
